baseUrl.title: Memos URL
baseUrl.description: Address of your Memos instance, e.g. https://memos.home.lan or https://usememos.com/… Use a host name: Super Productivity blocks private IP addresses (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x …) and localhost for plugin providers. A host name that resolves to a LAN address works. In the web version, the Memos server must allow CORS. The access token is set via the plugin menu entry "Memos: Set access token" (stored on this device only).

noteSyncEnabled.title: Sync task notes with Memos
noteSyncEnabled.description: Each task with notes gets its own memo. Tasks imported from Memos and checkbox subtasks are not synced.

syncSpace.title: Space for synced notes (optional)
syncSpace.description: Memos space for the note memos, e.g. "superprod" or "spaces/superprod". Empty: no space.

syncTag.title: Tag for synced notes (optional)
syncTag.description: Added to every note memo, without #. Memos with this tag are never offered as tasks.

pullIntervalMinutes.title: Check Memos for note changes every … minutes

onTaskDelete.title: When a task with a note memo is deleted
onTaskDelete.description: nothing: keep the memo · archive: archive the memo · delete: delete the memo

syncOtherProviderTasks.title: Also sync notes of tasks from other issue providers (GitHub, …)

token.title: Access token (fallback, synced!)
token.description: Only if the menu entry "Memos: Set access token" does not work for you. A token entered here is synced to all your devices and included in backups.
